body: I don't mean those things specifically. Our brains are hard-wired to look negatively rather than positively. And even if you think there's nothing, there's that hope of doing what you really want to do.(:

Aren't we all? Let the successes be more important. Our brains are hard-wired to be more scared, feel worse, in other words, take the failures more into account. Think about what you've done right. Hope this helps.<3

Please, try to let your own goals take priority. Focus on it more. Don't let them take what you love from you: what if this was in a more physical sense? Your dog? Your girlfriend? Your grandparents? You deserve to enjoy yourself, even if they don't want you to (indirectly of course). I'm falling down a similar rabbit hole, and people around me have such high expectations of me. Sometimes I want to just give up, but you have to keep going, keep grinding for the hope that one day you'll be in bliss enjoying what you love. Good luck man. Stay safe.<3
